An employee was delivering mail on July 10, 2024, when they became overheated. The employee was hospitalized for heat illness.

On July 11, 2024, an employee was getting out of a mail vehicle when he tripped between grass and concrete, fell forward down an embankment he was parked next to, and suffered a broken left wrist. He was hospitalized requiring surgery.
An employee tripped backward on a pallet of parcels on the floor as he was pulling a parcel out of a station area. The employee sustained numbness in his back and was hospitalized.

On July 15, 2024, an employee was pulling a cargo container out from the back of an airplane that was stuck. When it finally dislodged, it broke loose and struck the employee's right leg. The leg was broken.
An employee was walking on the dock carrying a flat tub when they tripped and fell on the floor. The employee sustained two broken ankles that required surgery.
An employee was stung by multiple wasps/bees after delivering a package to a home. The employee went into anaphylactic shock.
A postal employee felt weak and experienced blurred vision after completing their mail route. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
A letter carrier was hospitalized due to heat stress.
A mail carrier was delivering mail when a dog chased them causing them to fall down a flight of stairs and fracture their right fibula.
An employee was loading mail into a truck when his shoulder popped. He was hospitalized.
While performing a route inspection, an employee tripped over a parking block and fell, breaking their right arm.
An employee was completing residential deliveries and felt ill. They were hospitalized for dehydration.
An employee tripped while getting out of a truck and fractured her toe.
An employee was driving his route delivering packages to customers when he felt overheated and became ill. The employee was hospitalized with heat exhaustion and dehydration.
On August 5, 2024, employee had been delivering mail and sustained heat stroke.
A mail carrier was stepping out of a mail vehicle when she twisted her right foot and fell to the road surface. The employee sustained a fracture to their lower left leg near the ankle.

An employee was walking into the building after returning from his route which involves driving a delivery route for 8-9 hours a day. The employee felt hot and ill, and he started to experience aches and cramps. He was hospitalized for heat illness due to dehydration.
An employee was walking toward the breakroom when they were struck by a sit-down forklift that was backing up. The employee suffered an amputation of the left leg just below the knee.
An employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion after losing consciousness in a customer's yard.
An employee was using a hand truck to relocate an automated postal center (APC) machine. The machine and the hand truck fell on the employee. The employee sustained back injuries.

On August 17, 2024, an employee was walking back to their vehicle after dropping off a package at a customer's door. The customer's dog escaped through the door and attacked the employee, causing lacerations and puncture wounds to their left and right calves. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was hanging schedules/posters in the general office. He grabbed a bollard, lost his footing, and fell to the floor. The employee sustained an injury to his right quadricep muscle.
An employee was delivering packages when they experienced heat-related illness symptoms. They were hospitalized with an acute kidney injury due to dehydration.

An employee was delivering mail to a residence when two dogs came through the screen door and attacked the employee. The employee also tripped and fell while trying to avoid one of the dogs. The employee was hospitalized with bite wounds to their face and legs.

An employee was delivering mail when she tripped on an uneven sidewalk and fell forward onto the ground, hitting her right knee and the left side of her face. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured kneecap that required surgery.

An employee parked his box truck at a dock to unload. He went into the building and walked to the wrong dock. He was standing on the bumper of someone else's box truck and was about to open the door to unload when the vehicle started moving. He then fell 3 to 4 feet on to the concrete, breaking his ankle.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck when the truck malfunctioned and stopped suddenly, throwing the employee to the ground. The employee's right hip was broken.
An employee was delivering a package when a dog came out of the residence and bit her several times on both arms. The employee was hospitalized with severe lacerations to her arms and chest.

An employee was delivering a large parcel to a building. A dog appeared around the side of the garage and the employee ran away, falling into the street. The employee was hospitalized with fractures to his right tibia and fibula that required surgery.

On September 9, 2024, a postal carrier was unloading mail into a power jack and transporting it into the building. While pulling the equipment into the building, the employee tripped over the power jack, resulting in three broken ribs and a bruised lung.

An employee was using a mail truck to deliver mail when they struck a patch of loose gravel and the vehicle overturned onto its side. The employee suffered leg and ankle pain as well as road burn. The employee was hospitalized.

A maintenance employee climbed into a dumpster to realign scrap piping so it would not protrude from the dumpster. While in the dumpster he backed up, lost his footing, and fell on sharp scrap metal. The employee sustained a severe laceration to his arm.

On October 30, 2024, at 6:30 AM, an employee was operating a vehicle lift gate when his right foot became caught in the gap between the platform of the lift gate and the truck. The employee was hospitalized with open fractures in the foot that resulted in the amputation of his third and fourth toes.
An employee was walking between two all-purpose containers when they slipped and fell to the floor, resulting in a fractured leg and wrist, as well as a head laceration that required seven staples.
An employee was transporting stock when she tripped and fell to the concrete floor, resulting in hospitalization with fractures to her left wrist and right knee that required surgery.
An employee was unloading a postal truck when an over-the-road transport container fell on their foot/ankle, fracturing the foot/ankle.

An employee was walking to his car when he tripped over a board that was secured to the floor of the dock area. His left knee struck the cement dock. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery to repair a broken knee.
An employee was on a ladder working to change a sign. They lost balance and fell approximately 6 feet to the concrete floor. The employee was hospitalized with a hip injury.
On November 12, 2024, an employee was unloading a truck when the station dock door came down and struck his leg. He was hospitalized with a broken leg.

On November 14, 2024, at 1:43 p.m., an employee fell forward to the ground from the fourth step of a residential home while delivering mail. The employee was hospitalized due to head trauma that required sutures and staples.
An employee was operating a powered industrial truck/mule. As she was dismounting the mule, it ran over her right hand and fractured it.
An employee was walking on a grassy hill while delivering an item to a private residence when they slipped on the grass and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured ankle.

An employee was repositioning a load on a pallet while a forklift was lifting the pallet for repositioning. The forks hit the crossbar on the opposite side of the pallet, causing it to thrust forward into the employee's right index finger, which got caught between the pallet and a package track. The employee sustained a partial amputation to the right index finger.
An employee was working on a loading dock when she tripped on a rubber bumper stopper and fell to the ground, resulting in a broken hip.
An employee was delivering mail to a residence when they slipped on black ice in a residential driveway and fell. The employee sustained a fractured right hip.
An employee lost their balance while sorting packages and fell to the ground. The employee suffered broken ribs and was hospitalized.
On December 7, 2024, a forklift ran into a rack, which then struck an employee. The employee suffered a fractured right foot and was hospitalized.
An employee was operating a walkie rider pallet jack. When the pallet jack abruptly stopped on a divot in the floor, the employee was thrown to the floor and hospitalized for a lower back injury.
An employee slipped on a wet yellow parking strip in a parking lot. He fell backward onto the pavement and was hospitalized with torn quadriceps in both legs.

On December 13, 2024, an employee was loading a portable hydraulic lift onto the back of a stake bed truck. The equipment shifted in the truck and fell onto the employee, resulting in injuries to his face and back.

An employee was walking to the back door of the post office when they slipped on the icy ground due to freezing rain and fell. The employee sustained a torn rotator cuff in their right shoulder and a fractured right hip.
An employee was delivering a parcel when they slipped on ice in the customer's driveway and fell. The employee sustained a fractured lower right leg.
An employee was walking across the production floor when they were struck by a pallet being moved by a forklift. The employee sustained a hip injury requiring surgery.

Two employees were pushing hampers full of mail to a mail truck. The injured employee was struck in the leg by a wire container that fell out of the other employee's hamper, resulting in a tendon injury.
An employee was selecting packages from an extendable conveyor when his right ring finger was caught in the belt. The employee sustained an amputation of the finger at the distal joint.
On December 23, 2024, an employee slipped on black ice on steps while delivering mail to a residence and fell. The employee sustained a dislocated and torn left knee.
An employee was walking to deliver mail and fell into a grass-covered ditch, resulting in a broken right tibia and fibula.
On December 30, 2024, an employee was delivering mail when they tripped on a dog leash and fell to the concrete front porch. The employee sustained a fractured hip.
An employee tripped over a bucket and fell onto a metal cart. The employee sustained four broken ribs.

An employee was performing maintenance on an automated package processing system when a finger on their left hand became caught in the belt. The employee sustained a partial amputation of the distal fingertip.
An employee slipped on ice while walking to a car, fell, and suffered a broken kneecap. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was unloading mail into a dumpster machine. The employee's left little finger was caught between the over-the-rail (OTR) and a bar of the machine, and was partially amputated.
An employee was delivering mail on a walking route when they slipped on a sheet of ice and fell on the ground. The employee sustained a displaced malleolar fracture of the right ankle.
An employee was walking in the parking lot while on a break when they were struck by a vehicle, resulting in a head and leg injury.
An employee was struck from behind by a mail carrying unit, causing her to fall onto her right knee and sustain in a knee injury.
An employee was delivering mail when they fell to the ground and sustained a ruptured vein in a kidney.
An employee slipped on ice in a parking lot and fell. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was exiting a business after a mail delivery. The employee slipped on black ice and fell to the ground, suffering a broken leg.

At approximately 11:30 a.m. on January 24, 2025, an employee parked his truck at dock door 41, shut off the vehicle, and walked into the facility. He returned to dock door 40 to unload and as he opened the back door of the truck at that dock, it pulled away and the employee fell to the ground below. The employee sustained fractured vertebrae.
An employee was delivering a package at a customer location when they slipped and fell on an icy surface, resulting in fractured ribs and a ruptured spleen.
An employee was walking on a sidewalk delivering mail when they slipped on ice and fell, sustaining a broken right leg. The employee was hospitalized.
A mail carrier slipped on an icy surface and fell, suffering a broken right hip.
A letter carrier was walking on the city sidewalk on the way back to his vehicle after completing delivery of a walking relay. He slipped and fell on an icy sidewalk, sustaining a fractured left hip.

On February 16, 2025, an employee was delivering mail. She walked up to a porch to deliver a parcel, slipped on ice, and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a fractured left leg and was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering mail to a residence when they slipped on ice and fell down a set of cement steps. The employee was hospitalized with a broken ankle.

employer: National Center for Employee Development U.S. Postal Service
narrative: An employee was walking in a parking lot when he slipped on ice and fell on the ground, hitting his head. The employee sustained a brain bleed.
An employee was setting up rollers in a trailer to facilitate package loading. She picked up and then set down a roller, resulting resulting in an amputation of her right ring fingertip.

An employee was walking on the side of a belt when the belt jammed. While it was being unjammed, a 24-pound package fell from it and struck the employee's head. The employee suffered a head contusion, a concussion, and pain (in the head and neck) and was hospitalized.
An employee was performing janitorial duties and carrying bathroom supplies when he slipped on a guardrail mounting post and fell on his side. The employee's hip was fractured and required surgery.
A forklift backed into an employee who was standing on a dock. His left foot was broken and the skin was removed.
An employee was walking on the work room floor when their left foot was run over by a forklift. The employee was hospitalized with an injury to the foot and required surgery.

At about 3:15 a.m. on April 12, 2025, an employee was putting a pallet of mail onto a postal truck when the pallet shifted. The employee fell back off the truck's lift gate, landed on the floor, and suffered a broken femur. He was hospitalized, requiring surgery.

On April 15, 2025, an employee was delivering mail when they were attacked by three dogs, resulting in bites to the legs and arms. The employee also sustained a head laceration from falling as they were running away from the dogs.

An employee was on a dock, pushing a container full of mail on an incline. The container rolled backward and tipped over onto the employee's legs, causing him to fall and strike his head on the concrete floor. He sustained a laceration to his head and an injury to a tendon in his right leg, which required surgery.
While leaving the building, an employee fell down the stairs and broke a leg.

An employee was delivering a parcel to a residence when a dog escaped from the house and chased them. The employee tripped and fell to the ground, and the dog bit them on the right shin and calf. The employee was hospitalized with severe lacerations and punctures.

On May 13, 2025, a mail carrier was attacked by a dog while delivering a package. The employee suffered a loss of muscle on the right arm, lacerations to the left arm, and punctures and lacerations to both legs. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee became unwell while delivering mail. The employee was hospitalized, suffering from heat-related dehydration.
An employee was delivering a package to a house when they were attacked and bitten by a dog, resulting in a broken right wrist and an open wound on the left elbow.
An employee was getting out of the back of a mail truck and misstepped or stepped on uneven pavement and fell to the ground. The employee sustained a back fracture.
An employee was stepping out of their delivery truck when she stepped on an empty water bottle and sustained a broken left ankle.
An employee was delivering a package to a house when a dog came through the storm door, jumped on the employee, and bit them in the lower jaw.
An employee was using a razor blade to cut fabric on a seat cushion when the blade slipped and lacerated his left arm and wrist. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering mail when she fell approximately 4 feet from the back of her mail truck. The employee sustained a fractured and dislocated left arm that required surgery.
An employee was delivering mail when he was startled by a dog and fell backward, striking his head on the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a brain bleed.

An employee was delivering mail when a dog charged at him and attacked him, biting him. While escaping from the dog, the gate latch did not engage and he went to climb over the fence; he fell and suffered a broken leg.

employer: United States Postal Service Kenwood Office
narrative: At about 3:30 p.m. on June 9, 2025, an employee was walking through a parking lot when a vehicle that was involved in an accident with another vehicle spun, jumped a curb, crashed through a metal fence, and struck the employee. He landed on the vehicle's hood and suffered a concussion and hip and ankle fractures. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was delivering mail to a residential home when they tripped and fell on an uneven sidewalk. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left leg.

On June 17, 2025, an employee was returning to their vehicle after delivering mail to a private residence when they slipped/tripped on the sidewalk and fell, resulting in a fractured left forearm that required hospitalization.
A mail carrier developed heat illness while delivering mail. He was hospitalized.

An employee was exiting a tractor trailer. He fell face first from the cab of the truck, striking his head and face on the ground. The employee suffered scratches and bruises to his face and was hospitalized.
An employee had completed an 11-hour shift delivering mail. When he went home, he began to feel unwell and was hospitalized for heat illness.
On June 26, 2025, an employee was delivering mail on foot when he began to feel ill. The employee was hospitalized for heat exhaustion.
An employee was on their mail route and began to feel sick. They were hospitalized for possible heat illness and dehydration.
An employee was walking across the workroom floor when they fell and sustained a fractured hip. The employee required surgery.

An employee was scanning the placards of pallets of mail bundles when a forklift approached from the opposite side and began lowering and pushing his pallet load forward. It struck the pallet the employee was working on, causing it to shift and strike her. She fell to the ground and sustained a left hip fracture that required surgery.
On July 10, 2025, an employee tripped over a yellow pillar and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured left femur.
An employee reached into a hamper, picked up a package, and was hospitalized with a back injury that caused pain in his lower extremities.
An employee became overheated while delivering mail. The employee was hospitalized overnight, suffering from heat stress.
An employee was delivering mail inside a supermarket when he tripped over a pallet and fell on the floor. The employee sustained a fractured wrist and was hospitalized.
An employee was getting out of a postal vehicle when the door shut on his right ring finger, severing his fingertip. The employee's right ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee was delivering mail when they sustained heat exhaustion.

employer: U.S. POSTAL SERVICE BULK MAIL CENTER
narrative: An employee was clearing a mail jam on a conveyor belt when her arm got trapped between the rollers. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured arm that required surgery.

An employee was using a floor machine and chemical floor stripper to strip the finish from the floor. The employee slipped backward on the wet floor and landed on their back. The employee was hospitalized with chemical burns caused by the floor stripper.
A mail handler was moving BMCs on the loading dock when they fell from the loading dock to the concrete ground below. The employee was hospitalized with head trauma.
An employee was on the working floor when they slipped and fell, resulting in a fractured right hip.

A mail carrier was delivering mail when aggressive dogs approached. The dog's owner tried to restrain the dogs but one dog broke loose and the mail carrier pepper sprayed that dog. The dog's owner then pushed the mail carrier and he fell on the pavement and injured his neck. The mail carrier was hospitalized.
An employee was delivering mail to a mailbox when a dog bit the employee on the left arm in the elbow area. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was delivering a package when a dog attacked her. The employee sustained bite injuries to her right calf.

An employee was talking with a customer in their yard while delivering mail when a vehicle on the street lost control and struck the employee, resulting in ligament damage in their right knee and injuries to their neck, back, left thumb, and collarbone.
An employee was walking down stairs while wearing ice traction shoes when her foot became stuck and she fell to the ground. resulting in a fractured right wrist.

An employee was working to remove a stuck strap from a tray line while on an A-frame ladder. They fell 6 to 8 feet to the concrete floor, resulting in a head contusion and fractured ribs that required hospitalization.

On September 22, 2025, an employee was making a delivery to a home. When walking up the sidewalk to the home, the employee tripped, fell to the ground, and hit her head and face against the concrete. The employee was hospitalized due to a laceration to the face and a fractured orbital socket.

On September 29, 2025, a rural mail carrier was delivering parcels to a business when she tripped on a parking stop block in front of the business. She fell to the ground and sustained fractures to her left hip and pelvis. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee was closing the back door of a postal tractor trailer when their right ring fingertip was pinched, resulting in an amputation.
An employee delivered a package. On her way back to her vehicle she was attacked by two dogs that came from around a corner. She was hospitalized with dog bites.
An employee was walking back to a carrier case with mail in her hand when she tripped over a tub. Her back overarched as she fell, resulting in a fractured back that required hospitalization.

An employee was waiting for an operator to bring mail over to a mail sorting machine when she became pinned between the machine and a stack of pallets being pushed by a powered industrial truck (PIT). The employee suffered bruising and swelling on her hips, lower back, knees, and left side; a puncture wound to her left thigh from a machine screw; a crushed right hand with numbness and tingling; numbness to the left big toe; and a right wrist sprain.

An employee was working to deliver mail to an apartment building. She was waiting for a customer to move, to obtain clearance to the mailboxes. The door swung inward and closed on her right little finger. The top half of her finger was surgically amputated.
An employee was putting mail into mail boxes in a neighborhood. He tripped and fell while turning, landing on the ground and breaking his left hip.

An employee was unloading his trailer at the dock area when he was struck and run over by a reversing powered industrial truck (PIT). The employee was hospitalized with a crushed left heel, a dislocated ankle, and the removal of skin down to the muscle on his calf.
An employee was struck by a powered industrial truck while traveling through a staging area. The employee was hospitalized with a broken left foot.
A mail carrier was walking away from a desk in the office when he tripped over cords and fell to the floor. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured patella and required surgery.
An employee was driving a forklift. His left leg came in contact with a doorframe and was fractured. He was hospitalized.

An employee tripped over the registry sack that was placed near her feet and fell to the floor. She sustained a laceration on her forehead, fractured her kneecap, and sustained injuries to her tibia and fibula. She was hospitalized.
An employee was using a ladder to hang a display. While coming back down the ladder, she missed the last step and fell to the floor, fracturing her left knee. The employee required surgery.
An employee was decorating a bulletin board in the costumer lobby when she missed a step on a ladder and fell to the concrete floor. The employee sustained a fractured skull.
